main_text.head: EPIST. XXXIII.
Petrus Halloix J. Morino. Laudat illius de Baptismo Constantini sententiam, quam suam quoque esse libere profitetur.
main_text.p: Admodum Reverendo Patri P. J. Morino, Congregationis Oratorii Iesu Christi Presbytero, P. Halloix.

LItteras tuas longe gratissimas, & una doctissimum illud ἔντυπον[?] de Sancto Hyppolito, nuper recepi, pro quo ingentes tibi gratias ex corde ago. Valde enim gavisus sum intelligere, quidnam super difficili & intricata quæstione sentires, atque adeo quibus de causis ad id sentiendum movereris.

Equidem nihil dum video, quid illis valide opponi possit, si quid post occurrerit, scribam. Nunc enim sum in opere, quod quo propius lucem est, magis me distringit. De Baptismo Constantini magni, quem nemo unquam mihi persuadere potuit, aliàs fuisse quam in extrema ejus vita, læ-

page.notes: The initial L of "Litteras" is a large woodcut-style initial; it is joined to the word as "LItteras". The Greek word ἔντυπον is printed with a doubtful accent and is marked [?]. The catchword "tor" is the continuation of "lætor", printed at the lower right. The word "quæstione" and "læ-" keep their printed æ. The page is otherwise clean: no stamps, no marginal notes, and the "Digitized by Google" banner is left out.
